$description: Non-token configuration of the semantic spacing layer (the tokens are spacing.roles.tokens.json, spacing.sizes.tokens.json and spacing.exceptions.tokens.json). output / typesOutput: the generated CSS and the TypeScript lists of the names. prefix: the custom property prefix (`--space-*`, deliberately outside Tailwind's `--spacing-*` theme namespace, so no width, size or inset utility ever reads a role). modes: Today first (the default rendering, on `:root`), then one attribute selector per preview mode. desktopVariant: the Tailwind variant every utility switches to its `md` values with (a media query in the kit, a container query on the app column in the app). scale: the only values a preview mode may use. floors: minimum values per token side in the listed modes. coarsePointer: on touch screens the listed tokens (`*` globs) of one mode fall back to another mode; every `blockDimensions` dimension of every size not `exempt` (the sizes that are not targets) must be listed, so no control height escapes the fallback. families: the utility families of each kind (family -> CSS property and the axis or size dimension it reads; `space` = Tailwind's space-x/space-y child margins, `negate` = a negative margin). gapLevels / chromeGapLevels: gap roles whose values must not decrease along the list in any mode and width. chrome: the navigation chrome roles (owner decision 6) keep Today snapped to the scale in New and move at most one scale step (looser up, compact down, or stay); their exceptions carry their own mode values under the same rule. newBudget: the per-place change budget of New (owner decision 0), checked for every role and exception (an exception's change is its Today value against its role's New value).

today.description: Today: pixel-identical to the product before the roles; every exception keeps its own value.

new.description: New: every role at its one standard value; exceptions follow their role.

looser.description: New, looser: the same roles one step more generous (phone page gutters, phone item and surface x insets and the aside cards' x inset stay at New, so looser never narrows a phone line or an aside column).

compact.description: New, compact: the same roles one step denser; control heights fall back to New on coarse pointers.

floors.why: A tight inset never collapses to zero in compact (it is the padding of a chip or code box).
Every control target at least 24 px (WCAG 2.2 target size minimum, D-06); the tag is not a target.
A clickable row is a target (D-06).
Compact controls stay at least 28 px (D-06).

chrome.rule: new = Today snapped to the scale; looser = new or the next scale step up; compact = new or the next scale step down (at most the smallest step: owner decision 6)

newBudget.why: Owner decision 0: in New a place moves at most 4 px where its Today value is up to 24 px and at most 8 px above, at either width; a place that would move more is doing another job (reclassify it or split the role).

budgetExemptRoles.inset-flush: Padding that only spaces siblings goes to zero in New by rule; the parent's gap carries the space (checked by the dead-space audit instead).
